title: alchemilla alpina var. grossidens
intro: Alchemilla alpina var. grossidens, commonly known as Alpine Lady's Mantle, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. It is known for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help to soothe skin irritations, reduce swelling, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Lady's Mantle include its ability to calm and soothe skin conditions, such as eczema and acne, as well as its potential to reduce pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
